A5. Reduction of complexity and numerical solver

    For n nodes the number of possible connections via a given transport mode is on the order of O (n(n − 1)). To limit the computational complexity of
the optimization problem, the number of possible connections has been reduced by means of Delaunay triangulation (Morbee et al., 2012), which
allows to reduce the number of possible connections to O (n). All instances of the optimization problem are solved by considering a MIP gap of 1% and
by using the commercial solver Gurobi (Gurobi Optimization, 2021).
